name: Baamboozle
description_short: A whole-class team quiz game played on one shared screen — teachers browse and play ready-made games without requiring students to use individual devices.
creator: Baamboozle
internal_notes: Browsing and playing public library games requires no login — confirmed live. A free account is needed only to save favourites or create/edit games, which doesn't affect basic classroom use. cefr_level and age_group set to unknown rather than guessed: the public game library spans a huge, teacher-contributed range (A1 through C1 by search-result inspection) with no single site-wide level claim to record honestly. teaching_use left empty for the same reason iSLCollective's is: this is a broad, teacher-contributed library, not a single activity with one assessable skill focus.
